Description:
I still remember the first time I saw him step into the tavern- no, glide is the better word! For men, the world parted to make way for his clean leather boots. He moved with that blend of grace and danger, a man who seemed forever on the edge of a dance or a duel, never quite lettin' you guess which. And every time his hand brushed the hilt of his blade, my heart fluttered like a startled mockingbird. They say swashbucklers live for speed, for leaps across tavern tables and sprints along rooftop edges, and watchin' him move, I believe it.
He fights recklessly, like a gambler placin' bets. I've seen him turn a stumble into a killin' strike, a misstep into a dazzlin' flourish that left his foes blinkin' 'fore they even realized they lost their eye! It's maddenin', really, how he laughs in the face of danger, how he throws himself into the fray with the same confidence he brings to a card table. He plays 'em all with that infuriatin', irresistible charm, as if life itself were a game he was born to win.
And yet what unsettles me most is not his Blood in the Water, nor his blade, but the look he gives me right before he moves. The quiet, fleetin' softness in his eyes, as though he's apologizin' for bein' faster than I can follow... In those moments, he ain't the legend others whisper about, he's only him, the man who winks at danger and smiles at me as if he's riskin' his life on the hope that I'll smile back. I write this so I won't forget: lovin' a swashbuckler means lovin' the wind, never still, always brilliant, and forever racin' toward the next impossible flourish...
Quick Note: Rogues are masters of the shadows who focus on subtlety, teamwork or direct combat. While they don't directly cast magic, they can train in the strange arts of shadow techniques - scholars debate wether this is a form of the arcane, psionics or a mere trick of the light. Only rogues know.

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Swashbuckler-specific Abilities are not considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).

~Combo Machine~.Effect: Whenever a combo is triggered, the target takes....

~180 to Hell~.Effect:
Choose an Enemy within 3 meters.
You quickly dash to the diametrically opposite space, on its other side, at the same distance.
~180 to Hell~.Notes: For example, if you're 3 meters to the South of a Unit, you move so that you become 3 meters to the North of it. Your starting space, the Enemy, and your landing space must be on the same line. Requires a clear path, but you can circle 'round the back.

~Raise~.Effect:
Use immediately before rolling a Blood in the Water attack.
If the attack deals Damage equal to or above its _average_, gain {Gold}Gold equal to 200% of the rolled amount.
Otherwise, the attack misses.

~What Have We Here~.Effect:
You can spend 1 minute to fast talk a non-playable character to try to bamboozle their morality.
Make a Presence Check against their Presence Check.
If you succeed, _steal_ a random Quirk it has. Otherwise, they notice you're trying to bamboozle them.

~I Know A Guy~.Effect: Use when in a town or hub to add 1d4 to an Focus Check, to bring up a reason as to why you know extra details about it. It can be about a particular subject you've encountered before, a person you know there, etc.
~I Know A Guy~.Upgrade: Come up with a story on why you are already familiar with that subject matter!

Starting Abilities Description: Try to land Critical Strikes one after another! And make sure you use weapons that allow for Critical Strikes.

~Blood in the Water~.Effect:
If your last 2 offensive Acts both either triggered a {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} or a ~Combo~, your next targeted {Type} {A}Action Point Act deals +{Amount}% Damage.

{Variants}

~Sharp End~.Effect: Your next offensive attack or Ability deals +1d4 Damage and triggers its {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} and ~Combo~ effect anyway!
~Sharp End~.Upgrade: If it can not {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critically Strike')}, it further deals an extra +1d4 Damage and counts as a {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} anyway.

~Hack and Slash~.Notes:
Roll the attack only once. Weapon effects (like Critical Strikes), if necessary, are applied to the main target only.
This may benefit from Blood in the Water.

Variants.Name: Hack and Slash
Variants.Effect: melee 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units within weapon range, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Slice and Dice
Variants.Effect: melee 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units within weapon range.

Variants.Name: Lock and Load
Variants.Effect: ranged 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Point and Shoot
Variants.Effect: ranged 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target.

<Deflect>.Effect: Reduce the Damage of a weapon attack you or a Unit near you receives by 100%.
<Deflect>.Notes: Works for ranged weapons. Melee body parts are considered weapons.

~Payday~.Effect: For the rest of the Combat, gain 25 {Gold}Gold whenever you use an Action Point.

~All or Nothing~.Effect: Add 1d6 to an attack's Damage. If the total is _odd_, the attack misses, but you Heal for 1.

~Overunder Blow~.Effect:
You have +1 Focus (up to your Stat Limit).
Instead of dealing extra Damage with Blood in the Water, do one of the following:
SingleTable: 2. Single-Stun the target (Double-Stun for two-handed weapons)
4. Push the target that many meters
~Overunder Blow~.Notes: Pushing only works on non-Epic Units.

<At Me!>.Effect: After landing 2 non-Critical Strikes in a row on a Unit, inflict a random Status Effect from the following options. Then the Unit becomes immune to ^At Me!^ for the rest of the Combat.
<At Me!>.Upgrade: If they were both with a 2-handed weapon, the Status Effect applied is doubled (Double-Slowed, Double-Blind, etc)!
<At Me!>.Notes:
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

<10 Percent Luck>.Effect: Reroll one non-Check die you just rolled. If it rolls 1, the Act misses.

~Came To Collect~.Effect:
Use a ranged weapon to shoot a Worthy Unit for 1d4 Damage.
Then, if it died, choose a permanent upgrade for this Ability from below.
SingleTable: 1. Dice Upgraded to the next die type
3. Gain Gold equal to 1000% of the rolled Damage
~Came To Collect~.Upgrade: You can use this for Abilities that specify one-handed weapons.
~Came To Collect~.Notes: Cooldown improved follows the following pattern, starting from the base Cooldown: Once / 2 Turns, Once / Turn, Twice / Turn, Thrice / Turn, etc.

~Fundamentals I~.Effect: Pick one more Level 1 Class or Utility Talent.

~Strafe and Backpedal~.Effect: After you move from place 2 times on the same Round, your next weapon attack triggers its Critical Strike regardless, but misses if you roll 1 on at least one die.

<Duel To Death>.Requirement: Only usable on Units with 50% or more Health
<Duel To Death>.Effect:
Challenge a non-Epic Worthy Enemy to a duel to the death!
The two of you take Turns one after another until one of you reaches 0 Health.
Neither of you can move away from eachother until the duel is over.
If you win, roll on the table to permanently improve your Hero!
<Duel To Death>.Notes: First, you continue your Turn; then the Enemy has its turn. After the duel is over, resume Turn order, as if you just finished your Turn. All of these Turns happen on the same Round, as if in a vaccuum (e.g. Round number does not increase for some effects' purposes).

<Dry Gulch>.Effect: Your next attack deals extra Damage equal to 50% of how many meters you moved this Round.

~Drunken Bluff~.Effect:
After you roll an attack this Combat, you can make it miss on purpose.

Whenever you miss or do 0 Damage with an attack, your next one deals +1d8 Damage this Combat.

~Steady Hands~.Effect: Your multi-dice attacks that miss if they roll 1 on any of the dice now miss if they roll 1 on ~at least two~ of the dice.

~Off-Hand Shank~.Effect: Make 3 attacks with a one-handed weapon you haven't used this Turn that would normally scale with a Stat. These attacks do not add any Stat to the Damage, and miss if they roll 1 on any of the dice.
~Off-Hand Shank~.Upgrade: You may apply Sharp End, Blood in the Water, or similar effects to individual attacks.
~Off-Hand Shank~.Notes: If the weapon jams or breaks, it does so after you finish the attacks.

~Second Wind~.Effect: Gain +1 Action Point and a ~Combo~. This Turn, all your Acts miss if they roll 1 on any of the dice.
~Second Wind~.Downside: Only usable as your first Act on a Turn.

~Circle Round~.Effect: Slam the target 1d6 meters away from you. Then, if the space is not blocked, you can dash behind it.
~Circle Round~.Downside: Only usable immediately after a Blood in the Water attack.

<Swing Thing>.Effect:
Use when a Unit within 5 meters (or yourself) becomes affected by a Status Effect.
Slam it 1d8 meters in any direction.
<Swing Thing>.Notes: Requires a Whiplash item, which can be bought for 50 {Gold}Gold (or freely crafted for the same price in materials).

<Momentum Dance>.Effect: Gain 1 Shielding equal to your 400% of your Initiative.

<High Noon>.Requirement: Only usable on the 3rd Round of Combat
<High Noon>.Effect:
Make 6 attacks with a one-handed ranged weapon, which miss if they roll 1 on any of the dice.
Further High Noon attacks on the same Unit (after the first) deal -50% Damage.
<High Noon>.Notes: Each attack may miss individually, not all at the same time.

<Exude Damage>.Effect: Your first offensive melee Act every Turn deals Damage equal to your Movement Speed to all other Units within 2 meters of the main target.
<Exude Damage>.Notes: Excluding the main target and yourself.

~Sharp and Pointy End~.Effect:
~Use after you landed an offensive attack or Ability.~
~Add~ +1d4 Damage and trigger its {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} and ~Combo~ effect anyway!
~Sharp and Pointy End~.Upgrade: If it can not {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critically Strike')}, it also deals +1d4 Damage and counts as a {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} anyway.

~Switcheroo~.Effect:
After you deal at least 10 Damage with a {Type1} attack, your next {Type2} attack this Turn deals +1d4 Damage.

~Both Variants can trigger one after another.~

~Been There Done That~.Effect: Once per Adventure, you can introduce an _actually fact_ without spending a Plot Point.

~Loan Shark~.Effect:
Loan a non-playable character anywhere between 100 and 500 {Gold}.
After a set amount of time, you get it back with 1d100 interest.
If the interest is 9% or less, you get nothing back.

~Fold~.Effect: Use after you learn the result of a _random_ choice determined by the Quest Master. You can force the Quest Master to draw a different result.
~Fold~.Notes: For example, when you would get random loot, a random shop or upgrade, a random encounter, etc you can use this Ability to get a different one.

~Blackcheck~.Effect:
Use after you failed a Presence Check (that you could have passed) to play _Blackcheck_ with the Quest Master.
The Quest Master tells you the required number to pass.
Starting from your rolled Check result, you may roll 1d6 again and again, one after another, to try to get exactly the required number to succeed. If you go above that number, you fail.

~Weighted Coin~.Effect:
Use after a die is rolled.
Increase or decrease it by 1.

~Ace in the Sleeve~.Effect:
Make a melee weapon attack that misses.
The target becomes Dazed, Lagged, and Deafened, lasting until they do those Acts.
~Ace in the Sleeve~.Notes:
Normally, Status Effects last at most 1 Turn. For example, if you Deafen a Unit, the Deafen lasts until they use an Ability.
A Lagged Unit's next Movement costs +1 Action Point.
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.

~Hit-and-Run~.Effect: Immediately dash to where you began your Turn.

~Hold It Partner~.Effect:
Choose an ally.
This Turn, whenever you land a {Green('Critical Strike')}, ~Combo~, Blood in the Water attack, or miss an attack against a Unit, that Ally can also make a 1 {A}Action Point Act against that Unit.

~Keelhaul~.Effect: Make a free Movement Act, then you become Lagged.
~Keelhaul~.Notes: A Lagged Unit's next Movement costs +1 Action Point.

~Eye for an Eye~.Effect:
Use after you take 0 Damage or an attack against you misses.
You can immediately attack the attacker, if within range, with a 1 {A}Action Point attack.

~Perfect Setup~.Effect: Whenever you trigger a ~Combo~, you can deal 1d6 Damage to the target, or Heal another Unit you can see for 1d6.

~Gallows Shock~.Effect: Your attacks that trigger both a {Green('Critical Strike')} and a ~Combo~ Double-Stun the target.
~Gallows Shock~.Notes:
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Double-Stunned Unit has -2 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~Abstain~.Effect: After you roll a Blood in the Water attack, you can force it to not gain extra Damage, and you gain +1 {A}Action Point.

~Wanted Poster~.Effect:
At the start of each Combat, one random Enemy becomes _Wanted_. The first attack against a _Wanted_ enemy triggers its {Green(Critical Strike)}, if any.
When it die, you have 50% change to gain {Gold}Gold equal to its Max Health.

~Smoke and Mirrors~.Effect: You automatically dodge all* direct Damage instances that roll 1 on any of the dice against you.
~Smoke and Mirrors~.Upgrade: Monsters must make the die roll against you instead of taking the average.
~Smoke and Mirrors~.Notes: If it makes sense to dodge it, you can dodge it. You can't dodge Damage over time, stepping on obstacles, etc.

~Sharks in the Water~.Effect:
If your last 2 offensive Acts both either triggered a {Color('var(--green-color)' 'Critical Strike')} or a ~Combo~, your next targeted {Type} {A}Action Point Act deals +{Amount}% Damage.

{Variants}

~Devil's Bargain~.Effect:
After you spend {Mana}Mana, roll 1d10.
If you roll 4 or more, replenish 1 {Mana}Mana. Otherwise, the Act misses.

~Play Both Sides~.Effect:
You can start Combats on the enemy side of the battlefield.
If you do, you gain an extra free Turn. All Damage you deal to your Hero party members on this free Turn is also dealt to an enemy of choice, and vice-versa.

~Omertà~.Effect: Your regular* weapon attacks that don't trigger a {Green(Critical Strike)}, ~Combo~, or Blood in the Water always miss. The others always deal +1d12 Damage.
~Omertà~.Upgrade: Regular attacks refer to standard attacks not done through Abilities and not empowered by Abilities.

One Man Show.Effect:
While outnumbered, you start your Turns with an extra {A}Action Point for each extra Worthy Enemy outnumbering your party.

Also, passively, you gain +1 Presence and +1 Damage on every Damage instance you deal.
One Man Show.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.

Acrobatix Bellatrix.Effect:
Gain +15 Movement Speed and your first attack every turn gains +1 Damage for every meter moved.

You automatically pass all Hard Instinct Checks (that require at least 15). Go be like an arrow in the wind!
